profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Internal Platforms, Business-Critical Systems, Engineering Enablement, Secure Self-Service & Agentic Workflows
profile.summary:
I’m a Staff Software Engineer focused on internal platforms, revenue-critical systems, and developer productivity.

I build tools that turn manual, error-prone workflows into secure self-serve products that teams can rely on. At LinkedIn, that has meant lead investigation tooling, incident response systems, lead-routing and business-rule workflows, and secure AI-assisted experiences that help teams move faster without losing control of sensitive data.

I’m at my best when a problem is cross-functional, operationally important, and ambiguous enough that the solution has to balance speed, safety, and adoption. I enjoy partnering across engineering, operations, marketing, and security to align on architecture, ship durable systems, and make other engineers more effective through mentoring, reviews, and documentation.

If you are looking for someone who can go deep on systems and also create org-wide leverage, that is the kind of work I enjoy most.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led design and delivery of a self-serve lead investigation platform that replaced manual SQL, spreadsheet, and log-hunting workflows with secure read-only web views.
 - Built failure-focused views for silent and high-priority lead failures, turning fragmented investigation steps into a single shared source of truth for engineering, operations, sales, and marketing.
 - Owned and improved business rule and lead-routing workflows across multiple modules in the Citadel funnel, helping protect revenue-critical processing paths.
 - Led high-severity incident response, root cause analysis, and postmortem follow-through for recurring production issues affecting lead flow and system stability.
 - Led secure AI-assisted investigation experiences by combining gated access, structured production data, and low-latency retrieval patterns.
 - Mentored engineers and influenced broader engineering practices through code review, documentation, and cross-team unblock work.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led UI and product work for internal productivity applications used by Sales and Marketing teams.
 - Built accessible, maintainable web experiences that improved operational workflows and reduced friction for internal users.
 - Partnered with designers and engineers to modernize internal tools and improve usability, reliability, and maintainability.
 - Contributed to cross-functional technical decisions and supported delivery of important platform improvements.

positions.title: UI Engineer
positions.description:
Lead the UI development team in revamping  LinkedIn's intranet site known as Cinco.

Collaborate with designers to develop accessible web experiences for Brand and Marketing.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Database, application and web development
• Developed, tested and deployed modifications to business processes, adding new capabilities, updating business rules, or eliminating bugs
• Developed a solution in C++ to optimize how many of a single/mixed product(s) would fit in a container
• Optimized inefficient SQL queries to reduce impact on other processes
• Tracked down blocking queries using SQL Sentry, investigate and document root cause

Lead Web Developer (2010-2014)

• Architected and developed web application framework to serve auto-generated content from K&N’s CMS
• Integrated tracking in web application framework, used for investigating user behavior during untested use cases
• Improved code maintainability and reusability by introducing object-oriented design to web page applications
• Decreased load time by optimizing front-end pages using WebPageTest.org
• Redesigned and streamlined the checkout process for K&N’s e-commerce site, resulting in improved UX and an increase in conversion rate
• Re-architected backend data retrieval and logic for the vehicle search tool, resulting in reduced page load time, increased stability and a 97% increase in efficiency
• Integrated Authorize.Net, PayPal In-Context Checkout, Amazon Payments and WorldPay
• Collaborated in architecting and developing a tracking system for marketing emails
• Developed framework to enable multi-currency, international e-commerce across multiple websites
• Increased mobile presence by designing and developing mobile websites for all brands
• Developed B2B website, providing our customers the ability to generate orders, optionally pay by credit card and review past and current orders
• Developed web services Create Order, Order Status and Inventory Check

Lead EDI Developer (2006-2012)

• End-to-end integration of EDI (X12, UN/EDIFACT) transactions
• Improved EDI infrastructure by identifying and eliminating weaknesses in the process, resulting in virtually zero downtime

positions.title: Technology Specialist /  Marketing Coordinator
positions.description:
Technology Specialist: 

Developed custom solutions integrating Excel, Word, Access, GoldMine and SQL Server to increase staff productivity. Planned and created GoldMine Automated Process tracks to automate various business processes, including the Client Review process. Generated custom reports using Crystal Reports. Maintained computers and printers. Phone system administrator. Help desk, user support and phone system support.

Marketing Coordinator:

Planned, organized and coordinated marketing events. Proof, finalize and approve marketing pieces. Verified all marketing material met LPL compliance requirements.

honors.title: UED Rockstar
honors.description: Peer-nominated award for work accomplished on LinkedIn's Member Accessibility Survey.

honors.title: NCMA Catalog - Mobile Web - Gold
honors.description: Excellence in mobile web catalog categories.
honors.issuer: Issued by National Catalog Managers Association · Aug 2014

volunteerExperiences.description: Participated in packing food for those in need. Our entire group was able to pack 12,000 packages, each package capable of feeding 6 people.
Mentored high school students at James Lick in web development.

projects.title: Personal Photobooth
projects.description: Developed my own photobooth software using Canon's SDK. The solution uses a Canon SLR to take pictures, create a collage and print/email the collage.

projects.title: Custom Invoicing System
projects.description: Developed a custom invoicing system for customer. The process involves consuming manually entered time sheets, data validation and Excel-based invoice creation.
